nodes.label: Live Cross-Tab Unread Badges
nodes.rationale: Badges are scope-independent (derived from is_read in the DB) so they update live from any tab, distinct from session-read visibility which is per-tab; an unawaited authoritative re-query self-heals drift.

nodes.label: Session-Read Model (per-tab visibility)
nodes.rationale: An article marked read in one tab's scope stays dimmed-in-place only in that tab and is absent from every other tab, symmetric across tabs; kept per-tab (not global) so the actively-scrolled list never collapses/jumps under the user's thumb while still narrowing visibility scope from 'every tab' to 'the tab it was read in'. SessionReadTracker keys by scope (kAllScope or folder id).

nodes.label: Open Question — Mark-All-Read Cross-Scope Purge
nodes.rationale: When mark-all-read runs on a category tab, cleared articles remain in All's scope if also read there earlier and will still show dimmed in All. Alternative would purge from every scope; scope-local version was specified as the implementation, with the tradeoff flagged rather than decided.

nodes.label: AI Summary Reads Full Article QA
nodes.norm_label: ai summary reads full article qa

nodes.label: AI Article Summary (two-pass Gemini Nano)
nodes.rationale: Entirely on-device via Gemini Nano; two-pass read-then-write flow (pass 1 extracts key points non-streaming, pass 2 writes ~120-word summary streaming) so the model summarises the full extracted article body (capped 6,000 chars) rather than the short RSS teaser; chunks buffered and revealed atomically to avoid flicker; bullets only when article has multiple distinct points.

nodes.label: Thumb Zone Design
nodes.rationale: Core UX principle for one-handed operation: primary tap targets (nav bar, folder tabs, FABs, swipe targets) placed in the bottom ~40% 'green zone'; folder tabs hard-required at the bottom rather than top.

nodes.label: Tier C — AI Summary Reads Whole Article
nodes.rationale: Original bug: summary generation used only the RSS teaser description, truncated further in Kotlin to 1200 chars, so the model 'summarised a summary'. Fix extracts full article body first via ArticleExtractor/SummarySource (6000-char cap) and does two Kotlin passes (read then write) so bullets appear only for multi-point articles.
nodes.norm_label: tier c — ai summary reads whole article

nodes.label: B1 — Cross-Tab Unread Counts Update Live
nodes.rationale: Optimistic updates applied at every read-state mutation site so badges update without a full reload; a 150ms-debounced unawaited authoritative re-query self-heals arithmetic drift, avoiding a per-scroll-frame synchronous re-query.
nodes.norm_label: b1 — cross-tab unread counts update live

nodes.label: B3 — Global Loading Indicator
nodes.rationale: Every user-initiated or view-changing async operation shows a shared top-edge progress bar via LoadingController.run(), which fades in after 150ms to avoid flashing on instant operations and fades out on completion or error; additive to, not a replacement for, existing local spinners.

nodes.label: B4 — Refresh Article List on App Resume
nodes.rationale: Resume fetch runs with coldStart:false explicitly to avoid cleanup deleting read articles mid-session, preserving PRD §4.3 list-persistence guarantee; scroll offset restore is accepted as imperfect since new articles insert above the current position.
nodes.norm_label: b4 — refresh article list on app resume

nodes.label: Real Claude Haiku Summary QA (Anthropic API)
nodes.norm_label: real claude haiku summary qa (anthropic api)

nodes.label: Anthropic API (Claude Haiku) — Not Implemented
nodes.rationale: Originally planned cloud AI summary path using Claude Haiku with user-supplied API key was superseded by the shipped Gemini Nano on-device approach — no API key, no network call, no cloud dependency.

nodes.label: Migration Strategy (onUpgrade)
nodes.rationale: Never DROP TABLE in a migration; always add columns with defaults and increment schema_version, so every upgrade path (e.g. v1→v3) must be tested, not just adjacent versions.

nodes.label: Newspaper Mode
nodes.rationale: Opt-in printed-newspaper aesthetic (newsprint background, PT Serif/Playfair Display serif type, red spot-colour accent) overriding theme choice; bundled OFL fonts avoid runtime font fetching; off by default so it never affects the native-feel mandate.

nodes.label: Keyword Blocking
nodes.rationale: Flagship feature that fixes Palabre's broken keyword-blocking implementation; case-insensitive partial match by default with optional whole-word mode, retroactively applied to existing unread articles.

nodes.label: Keyword Matching Case-Sensitivity Fix
nodes.rationale: Bug: keyword_matcher.dart was case-sensitive so 'Crypto' would not block 'crypto'; fixed to case-insensitive in both default and whole-word modes.

nodes.label: Swipe Mark-as-Read Fix
nodes.rationale: Bug: swiping removed the article from the list and right-to-left swipe marked unread; fixed so both swipe directions mark as read and dim in-place.

nodes.label: Hard Requirement 3 — Dual Accent Color ThemeData
nodes.rationale: Distinct accent palettes for dark (electric yellow) vs light (deep amber gold) mode rather than one shared color, wired via ColorScheme with dynamic_color as an Android 12+ override.
nodes.norm_label: hard requirement 3 — dual accent color themedata

nodes.label: Hard Requirement 1 — Folder Tabs at Bottom
nodes.rationale: Default Flutter TabBar/TabBarView at the top is explicitly rejected; instead a PageView plus a custom bottom-anchored scrollable tab row is required to satisfy the thumb-zone design principle.
nodes.norm_label: hard requirement 1 — folder tabs at bottom

nodes.label: Hard Requirement 2 — Radial Context Menu on Long-Press
nodes.rationale: BottomSheet/PopupMenuButton rejected in favor of a circular radial menu (OverlayEntry, 3 elements: Share, Summary, X dismiss), matching Palabre's original implementation.
nodes.norm_label: hard requirement 2 — radial context menu on long-press
